description:
Brand Introduction:

Laven & Ivory is a dynamic and innovative brand dedicated to providing high-quality products that enhance everyday experiences. Our product range focuses on essentials that cater to various lifestyles, including phone accessories, home goods, and more. We pride ourselves on exceptional quality, customer satisfaction, and a commitment to sustainability. By joining our affiliate program, you’ll partner with a brand that values collaboration and growth, aiming to deliver outstanding products to customers while earning competitive commissions.

Product Description:

Our diverse product lineup includes cutting-edge phone accessories, durable bike phone mounts, and versatile home products designed to make life easier and more enjoyable. Each item is carefully crafted with the highest standards of quality and functionality, ensuring they meet the needs of modern consumers. Our products, such as the Quad Lock Bike Phone Mount and the 3-in-1 MagSafe Charger, are designed for durability and performance, appealing to tech-savvy customers and outdoor enthusiasts alike.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

Laven & Ivory stands out in the marketplace due to our commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Our unique selling points include:

  • Premium Quality: Each product is made with high-grade materials to ensure longevity and reliability.
  • Innovative Design: Our products feature modern designs and advanced technology, making them user-friendly and stylish.
  • Exceptional Support: We prioritize customer service, offering dedicated support to ensure a seamless shopping experience for our customers and partners.
  • Competitive Commission Rates: Our affiliate program offers attractive commission structures, allowing affiliates to earn substantial income.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission Rate: Affiliates will earn a commission of 15% on each sale generated through their referral link.
  • Payment Method: Payments will be processed via bank transfer on a weekly basis.
  • Minimum Payout: The minimum payout threshold is set at £50. Affiliates will receive payments once they reach this threshold.

Other Information:

  • Tracking & Analytics: Affiliates will have access to a dedicated dashboard where they can track their sales, commissions, and performance metrics in real-time.
  • Support & Communication: Our affiliate support team is available to assist with any questions or concerns. We also provide regular updates on new product launches, promotions, and tips for maximizing earnings.

By joining the Laven & Ivory affiliate program, you’ll be part of a thriving community dedicated to sharing quality products and enhancing customer experiences. Together, we can achieve great success!
